scheme_name: Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a resident of the U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have completed one year membership with the Board
Must not have a pucca house
Proposed house must be constructed on the applicant's own land
benefits_summary: Provides a token amount of up to ₹75,000 (or reduced amounts under specific housing schemes) for constructing a house on the applicant's own land.
